question: interior-finishes-to-schedule
unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one 800 m2 NLA tenancy floor, level 4, Auckland CBD)

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one 800 m2 NLA tenancy floor, level 4, Auckland CBD)
band.basis: Bottom-up QV CostBuilder build-up at Auckland (AKL) rates, GST exclusive. Six finishes plus substrate prep priced from cited QV rows; wall prep, trims, protection, waste, setout and the out-of-hours access loading priced as stated allowances. Sum of the lowest rates = $153,794; sum of the highest = $208,782; sum of midpoints = $181,288 (about $227/m2 over the 800 m2 NLA; the brief's midpoint was $170,000 / $213/m2). Carpet tile is the largest single line at $64,000-72,960 (about 38% of the package) and, with the latex smoothing compound ($24,674-36,500), is fully QV-sourced - so the main cost drivers are cited, not allowed. Allowances total about $19,000-38,500, roughly 12-18% of the band, which is under a third, so the band is established rather than not established. The two widest items are the LVT-plank proxy (QV has no LVT row) and the out-of-hours access loading; the batten wall depends heavily on the 60 mm centre spacing. All QV rows are UNREVIEWED and should be caveated in any cost plan.

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one tenancy floor)
band.basis: Sum of six cited QV finish components plus two package allowances; all rates AKL column, NZD, GST exclusive. Allowances carry ~10% of the total, so confidence is not driven down by them. Largest lines: carpet tile ~41% and latex smoothing ~18%, both QV-sourced. Centre $168,000 = ~$210/m2 over 800 m2 NLA. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent fees, base-build plasterboard/partitions/framing, ceilings, joinery/glazing/signage, floor levelling beyond latex smoothing, asbestos/removal and scaffolding/hoists/lift protection. Substrate sanding/stopping/sealing is not added separately because the QV covering and paint rows already include prep/sealer (avoiding double count).

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one tenancy floor, 800 m2 NLA)
band.basis: Sum of cited QV CostBuilder rates (Auckland) and stated minor allowances, all GST-exclusive, NZD, level 4 of an existing Auckland CBD office building, lift access only. Carpet tile is the largest driver (640 m2, ~40% of the package) and is well matched by QV 'Tiles, Heavy Duty Loose laid, Nylon 100%' ($100/m2 AKL, siblings $105-$114); the latex smoothing compound is the second driver (730 m2) and is the main reason the high end exceeds the scenario, because QV's floor-prep rows run $33.8-$50/m2 versus the scenario's $22/m2. Vinyl wall covering and LVT are priced from stated proxies with adjustments. Allowances (MDF substrate, wall prep, waste, setout/out-of-hours) carry only ~10% of the total, well under a third. Mid-point ~$175,000 = ~$219/m2 over 800 m2 NLA. Band is a cost-plan working estimate, not a certified price; excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent fees and all listed exclusions.
